function selectStateCase(variant) {
 const checks={},make=tag=>document.createElement(tag),throws=fn=>{try{fn();return false}catch(e){return e instanceof TypeError}},f=make('form'),s=make('select');f.id='select-form-'+variant;f.append(s);document.body.append(f);
 checks.brands=s instanceof HTMLSelectElement&&s.options instanceof HTMLOptionsCollection&&s.options instanceof HTMLCollection&&s.selectedOptions instanceof HTMLCollection&&!(s.selectedOptions instanceof HTMLOptionsCollection);
 checks.constructors=throws(()=>new HTMLSelectElement())&&throws(()=>new HTMLOptionsCollection())&&throws(()=>new HTMLOptGroupElement())&&HTMLSelectElement.length===0&&HTMLOptionsCollection.length===0;
 checks.empty=s.length===0&&s.selectedIndex===-1&&s.value===''&&s.type==='select-one'&&s.form===f;
 const options=s.options,selected=s.selectedOptions;checks.sameObject=options===s.options&&selected===s.selectedOptions;
 const a=new Option('A','a'),b=new Option('B','b');a.id='a-'+variant;b.id='b-'+variant;s.append(a,b);checks.implicit=s.selectedIndex===0&&s.value==='a'&&a.selected&&!b.selected&&!a.defaultSelected;
 checks.collections=options.length===2&&options[0]===a&&s[1]===b&&s.item(0)===a&&s.item(4)===null&&options.item(1)===b&&s.namedItem(b.id)===b&&options.namedItem(a.id)===a&&options[a.id]===a;
 checks.iterators=[...s].join('|')===[a,b].join('|')&&[...options][1]===b&&selected.length===1&&selected[0]===a;
 let changes=0;s.addEventListener('input',()=>changes++);s.addEventListener('change',()=>changes++);b.selected=true;checks.choose=b.selected&&!a.selected&&s.selectedIndex===1&&s.value==='b'&&selected[0]===b&&b.matches(':checked')&&!a.matches(':checked')&&changes===0;
 const sheet=make('style'),colorSelect=make('select'),colorA=new Option('ColorA'),colorB=new Option('ColorB');colorSelect.append(colorA,colorB);document.body.append(colorSelect);colorB.selected=true;sheet.textContent='option:checked{color:rgb(12,34,56)} option{color:rgb(1,2,3)}';document.head.append(sheet);checks.cssSelected=getComputedStyle(colorB).color==='rgb(12, 34, 56)'&&getComputedStyle(colorA).color==='rgb(1, 2, 3)';colorA.selected=true;checks.cssChanged=getComputedStyle(colorA).color==='rgb(12, 34, 56)'&&getComputedStyle(colorB).color==='rgb(1, 2, 3)';colorSelect.remove();sheet.remove();
 b.selected=false;checks.clearOption=a.selected&&!b.selected&&s.selectedIndex===0;s.selectedIndex=-1;checks.clearIndex=!a.selected&&!b.selected&&s.value===''&&selected.length===0;
 a.defaultSelected=false;checks.noopDefault=s.selectedIndex===-1;s.value='b';checks.value=b.selected&&!a.selected&&s.selectedIndex===1;s.value='missing';checks.missing=s.selectedIndex===-1&&!a.selected&&!b.selected;
 a.defaultSelected=true;checks.cleanDefault=a.selected&&!b.selected&&s.selectedIndex===0;b.defaultSelected=true;checks.dirtyDefault=a.selected&&!b.selected;
 f.reset();checks.reset=b.selected&&!a.selected&&a.defaultSelected&&b.defaultSelected;a.defaultSelected=false;a.defaultSelected=true;checks.resetDirty=a.selected&&!b.selected;
 s.multiple=true;b.selected=true;checks.multiple=a.selected&&b.selected&&selected.length===2&&s.value==='a'&&s.type==='select-multiple';s.multiple=false;checks.single=a.selected&&!b.selected&&selected.length===1;
 s.size=3;s.selectedIndex=-1;checks.listbox=s.size===3&&s.selectedIndex===-1;s.size=0;checks.dropdown=s.size===0&&s.selectedIndex===0;
const sizeProbe=make('select');sizeProbe.setAttribute('size','2147483648');sizeProbe.append(new Option('Size'));checks.sizeLarge=sizeProbe.size===0&&sizeProbe.selectedIndex===-1;sizeProbe.size=2147483648;checks.sizeSetter=sizeProbe.size===0&&sizeProbe.getAttribute('size')==='0'&&sizeProbe.selectedIndex===0;sizeProbe.setAttribute('size','0'.repeat(20000)+'2x');checks.sizePrefix=sizeProbe.size===2;
 const c=new Option('C','c',true,true);s.prepend(c);checks.selectedInsertion=s.selectedIndex===0&&c.selected&&!a.selected&&!b.selected;c.remove();checks.selectedRemoval=c.selected&&s.selectedIndex===0&&a.selected;
 s.selectedIndex=-1;const d=new Option('D','d');s.prepend(d);checks.emptyInsertion=d.selected&&s.selectedIndex===0;
 s.selectedIndex=2;s.prepend(d);checks.unselectedMove=b.selected&&!d.selected&&s.value==='b';
 const detached=new Option('X','x',true);checks.factory=detached.defaultSelected&&!detached.selected&&detached.text==='X'&&detached.value==='x'&&detached instanceof Option&&Option.prototype===HTMLOptionElement.prototype;
 const missing=new Option(undefined,undefined);checks.factoryMissing=missing.text===''&&!missing.hasAttribute('value');const nulls=new Option(null,null,false,true);checks.factoryNull=nulls.text==='null'&&nulls.value==='null'&&nulls.selected&&throws(()=>Option());
 s.length=1;checks.shrink=s.length===1&&s[0]===d;s.options.length=3;checks.grow=s.length===3&&s[1].text===''&&s[2].value==='';
 const e=new Option('E','e');s[1]=e;checks.indexSetter=s[1]===e&&s.length===3;s.options[4]=new Option('F','f');checks.indexExpand=s.length===5&&s[3].text===''&&s[4].value==='f';s.options[2]=null;checks.indexRemove=s.length===4&&s[3].value==='f';
 const group=make('optgroup'),g=new Option('G','g');group.append(g);s.add(group,0);checks.group=group instanceof HTMLOptGroupElement&&s[0]===g&&g.index===0;group.disabled=true;group.label='group';checks.groupReflection=group.disabled&&group.label==='group'&&g.matches(':disabled');group.disabled=false;
 const h=new Option('H','h');let nestedError=false;try{s.options.add(h,g)}catch(e){nestedError=e.name==='NotFoundError'}s.options.add(h,group);checks.addNested=nestedError&&h.parentNode===s&&s[0]===h;s.remove(0);checks.removeIndexed=h.parentNode===null&&s[0]===g;s.options.remove(0);checks.removeCollection=g.parentNode===null;
 const outside=make('option');let notFound=false;try{s.add(outside,make('div'))}catch(e){notFound=e.name==='NotFoundError'}checks.addErrors=notFound&&throws(()=>s.add(make('div')))&&throws(()=>s.options.add())&&throws(()=>s.options.remove());
 s.innerHTML='<option id="first" selected>First</option><option id="second" selected>Second</option>';checks.html=s.length===2&&s.selectedIndex===1&&s.value==='Second'&&options[1]===s[1]&&selected[0]===s[1];
 const first=s[0],second=s[1];s.value='absent';first.setAttribute('selected','new');checks.samePresent=s.selectedIndex===-1;first.removeAttribute('selected');first.setAttribute('selected','');checks.readdedDefault=first.selected&&!second.selected;
 s.selectedIndex=1;first.setAttributeNS('urn:example:test','x:selected','');checks.namespace=!first.selected&&second.selected;
 const fresh=make('select'),p=new Option('P','p'),q=new Option('Q','q');fresh.append(p,q);f.append(fresh);const attr=document.createAttribute('selected');attr.value='';q.setAttributeNode(attr);checks.attributeNode=q.selected&&!p.selected;attr.value='new';checks.attributeValue=q.selected;q.removeAttributeNode(attr);checks.attributeRemoval=p.selected&&!q.selected;
 const other=make('form');other.id='other-select-'+variant;document.body.append(other);fresh.setAttribute('form',other.id);checks.owner=fresh.form===other&&q.form===other;fresh.selectedIndex=1;f.reset();checks.unownedReset=fresh.selectedIndex===1;other.reset();checks.ownedReset=fresh.selectedIndex===0;
 const cancel=e=>e.preventDefault();other.addEventListener('reset',cancel);fresh.selectedIndex=1;other.reset();checks.cancelReset=fresh.selectedIndex===1;other.removeEventListener('reset',cancel);
 s.options.selectedIndex=0;checks.collectionSelectedIndex=s.selectedIndex===0&&s.options.selectedIndex===0;
 let clicked=false;s.addEventListener('click',event=>clicked=event.target===s);s.click();checks.proxyIdentity=clicked&&document.getElementById(f.id).firstChild===s&&s.parentNode===f&&s instanceof HTMLElement;
 const desc=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLSelectElement.prototype,'selectedIndex');checks.receiver=throws(()=>desc.get.call({}))&&throws(()=>desc.set.call(make('input'),0))&&throws(()=>s.selectedIndex=1n)&&throws(()=>s.size={valueOf:()=>1n});
 Object.defineProperty(s,'options',{value:[],configurable:true});checks.optionsOverride=s.item(0)===first&&[...s][0]===first;delete s.options;
 const keys=Object.keys(s);checks.indexKeys=keys.includes('0')&&keys.includes('1')&&Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(s,'0').writable;
 checks.foreignGet=Reflect.get(s,'0',{})===s[0];const receiver={};const replacement=new Option('Foreign','foreign');Reflect.set(s,'0',replacement,receiver);checks.foreignSet=receiver[0]===replacement&&s[0]===first;
 for(const action of ['sameTrue','sameFalse','changeTrue','changeFalse']){const t=make('select');t.innerHTML='<option>A</option><option>B</option>';const x=t[0],y=t[1],target=action==='sameFalse'||action==='changeTrue'?y:x;target.selected=action==='sameTrue'||action==='changeTrue';t.selectedIndex=target===x?1:0;target.defaultSelected=true;checks['dirty'+action]=t.selectedIndex===(action==='sameFalse'?1:0);}
 for(const position of [0,1]){const t=make('select');t.innerHTML='<option>A</option><option>B</option>';const target=t[position];target.selected=true;t.value='missing';target.defaultSelected=true;const added=t.selectedIndex;target.defaultSelected=false;target.defaultSelected=true;checks['dirtyEmpty'+position]=added===(position===0?0:-1)&&t.selectedIndex===added;}
 const resize=make('select'),observer=new MutationObserver(()=>{});observer.observe(resize,{childList:true});resize.length=3;const grown=observer.takeRecords();checks.resizeRecords=grown.length===3&&grown.every(record=>record.addedNodes.length===1&&record.removedNodes.length===0)&&grown[1].previousSibling===grown[0].addedNodes[0];const removedOption=resize[1];resize.length=1;const shrunk=observer.takeRecords();checks.shrinkRecords=shrunk.length===2&&shrunk[0].removedNodes[0]===removedOption&&resize.length===1;observer.disconnect();
let disconnected=0;const probeName='select-state-probe-'+variant;customElements.define(probeName,class extends HTMLElement{disconnectedCallback(){disconnected++}});const customSelect=make('select'),customOption=make('option');customOption.append(make(probeName));customSelect.append(customOption);document.body.append(customSelect);customSelect.length=0;checks.resizeCustom=disconnected===1;customSelect.remove();
 s.remove();checks.removeSelf=s.parentNode===null&&s.length===2;other.remove();f.remove();return checks;
}
